prepareDueNotificationDeliveries.reason: Both representations select retryable due email failures and, when the mailer is configured, due pending-disabled emails. The bounded reader owns the selected rows through MutateNotificationDelivery. TestNotificationReadCallerEffects compares status, attempts, errors and next-attempt state with the flag off and on.

processDueDeliveries.reason: DueIntegrationDeliveryIDs visits eligible IDs in installed order in both representations. It leaves delivery payloads and previous values in the store. TestScaleHotDeliveryContextSourceAndCountBound covers order, future and terminal failures, attempt limits and large unrelated payloads. Downstream delivery and sweep readers are reviewed independently.
processDueDeliveries.temperatureReason: Unconditional delivery scheduler tick scans each workspace and dispatches due notification/integration work.
